original_scale_contract.threshold_policy: all spatial regions and plane bands are max(3*dp,0.02 m); no single-particle topology

current_operator_protocol.scope: actual F4 typed HDF5 reference evidence; every curve is bound to physical and control hashes

physical_support.support_radius_semantics: fixed physical distance, independent of dp; max(3*dp,0.02 m) is retained only as a labelled resolution diagnostic
physical_support.contact_definition: at least the registered cross-source pair and mass thresholds are true in the converted typed active particle positions; initial source boxes are never used as contact evidence
physical_support.recontact_definition: a false interval after first sourced contact followed by a later sourced contact; right-censored when absent
physical_support.spread_definition: axis-aligned extent of each typed source group over active finite-mass particles
physical_support.calibration: translation, rotation, and deterministic subsampling fixtures are run through the same support detector and recorded with the audit

transport.plane: finite physical y/z aperture derived from the registered source geometry, not an infinite x plane
transport.crossing: typed identity-resolved signed crossings with native mass in kg; repeated crossings and first-passage brackets are retained
transport.missing_identity_policy: unknown state; missing particles are excluded from active aperture sums and never counted as physical exit

comparison.time_alignment: linear interpolation at actual time values over the overlap window; frame index equality is not assumed
comparison.macro_scales: native mass, registered L, M*U momentum, and M*U^2 energy; no trajectory mass normalization
comparison.status_policy: observed pass/fail/fail-over-budget is evidence only and grants neither Q-N nor production eligibility

preview.projection: actual solver Cartesian x/z with y as color
preview.downsample: deterministic display-only sample; full HDF5 remains the audit input
preview.required: first/middle/final keyframes and at least one frame-sequence GIF

current_operator_protocol.claim_boundary: Q-I lifecycle and scientific reference evidence are reported separately; Q-N and production are not assessed

COL.macro_definition: full original per-source extrema, native mass, L, M*U momentum and M*U^2 energy; no percentile substitution
COL.mass_policy: registered continuum denominator retained; no mass rescaling
